scene: A chat in a centred, narrower window
narration: You ask for the survey results; it finds them and tells you what came first.

messages.text: Find the results of our staff training survey. Which topics do people want most? Don't give me a table, show me.
I found the 2026 results on the HR team site: 212 responses. Using AI tools safely comes first overall, but not in every department. Pick a department to see how it changes.
